Class GUIUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.GUIUtils

  • final class GUIUtils
extends java.lang.Object
    Provides utility methods for JavaFX user-interface operations, node traversal, and popup dialogs.

      • getById

        static <T extends javafx.scene.Node> T getById(javafx.scene.Node root,
                                               java.lang.String id,
                                               java.lang.Class<T> type)
        Retrieves a node by ID, verifies its type, and casts it to the expected type.
        Type Parameters:
        T - the expected node type
        Parameters:
        root - the root node from which to begin the search
        id - the target JavaFX node ID
        type - the expected node type token, for example TextField.class
        Returns:
        the matching node cast to T
        Throws:
        java.util.NoSuchElementException - if no node with the specified ID exists
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if a node with the specified ID exists but is not an instance of type

      • getById

        static javafx.scene.Node getById(javafx.scene.Node root,
                                 java.lang.String id)
        Recursively searches the specified JavaFX node hierarchy for a node with the given ID.
        Parameters:
        root - the root node from which to begin the search
        id - the JavaFX ID to search for
        Returns:
        the first node whose ID matches id, or null if no matching node is found
